title: Real Estate
description: Closings, landlord-tenant matters, partition actions, and title or boundary disputes. Property is usually a family's largest asset, so the losses are correspondingly large.
intro: Real estate disputes are unusually time-sensitive: whether a deposit is recoverable, where an eviction proceeding stands, whether a co-owner has already disposed of an interest — each has a firm deadline. We first confirm which stage you're at and how much time remains, then discuss approach. (This is general information about how such matters usually proceed, not advice on your specific case. Where representation is needed, a licensed attorney at a partner law firm handles it.)
